verdict.rationale: The evidence documents per-message operations (draft, update, delete), the ability to filter or search across the mailbox, and Inbox rules that act on incoming messages. None of it shows a capability to apply one action across many existing items at once. There is no batch request support and no bulk move, delete, or update. Mailbox-wide querying and rules for incoming mail are adjacent building blocks, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
